assumption: Incoming spin is zero after the free strike. Capture uses kinetic friction until v = ω R, continuously. The groove then enforces rolling.

phases.name: capture
phases.note: Kinetic friction during slip. Not the rail's later constraint force.

phases.name: rail
phases.note: While the contact point is instantaneously at rest, normal and static friction do no work. Local upslope is allowed.

landing.note: Next musical contact. Position is the passive landing, not a coordinate copied from the free-flight plan.

references: OpenStax University Physics Volume 1, §11.1: rolling KE and why static friction does no work.
Pinball habitrails are passive wire guides. A vertical up-kicker is a powered device and is not this transition.
